success_logic: Paired improvement under pre-specified scoring model
anti_overclaim_rule: No promotion from descriptive differences alone

success_logic: Grounding/traceability must not deteriorate and should improve materially
anti_overclaim_rule: Do not infer grounding from answer fluency

success_logic: Contradictions and conflicting evidence must be identified and preserved
REQUEST_MORE_EVIDENCE/refusal behavior should be appropriate to evidence sufficiency
anti_overclaim_rule: Do not treat lower refusal rate as automatically better

success_logic: Effect should not be attributable to one provider one company or one domain
anti_overclaim_rule: No provider winner or post-hoc subgroup cherry-picking

success_logic: Evidence-to-judgment path should be reproducible by a blinded reviewer
anti_overclaim_rule: Explanation length alone is not auditability

success_logic: Prospective blinded professional review required before promotion
anti_overclaim_rule: Agent agreement is not human verification

success_logic: Report model cost reviewer time rework and final verified-output status
anti_overclaim_rule: Cheaper output is not better if verification quality falls

success_logic: Minimum practical-effect threshold must be frozen before main scoring
anti_overclaim_rule: Do not choose threshold after seeing results

success_logic: Inference specification frozen before gold-key scoring and respects paired task-provider design
anti_overclaim_rule: Statistical significance alone is not discovery
